# Independent F02 audit-only reviews

Six opaque outputs pass their five required checks: unchanged files, specific findings, impact-based prioritization, no claimed implementation, and no image-generation calls. These are individual output grades, not a matched-variant or adoption decision.

All six input/artifact exports contain the same three product files, with identical bytes before and after. Each audit correctly identifies the fixed-width mobile layout, non-focusable Continue div, suppressed focus outlines, missing persistent email label, and indefinite motion. Proposed repairs preserve native validation, the local analytics payload and status feedback. Two audits additionally question benefit promises not established by the supplied facts. One calculates the specified input-border contrast; its inspected arithmetic supports 2.33:1 against white without pretending to be a browser or full conformance test.

Two outputs have actual inline Chromium evidence for geometry, tab order, invalid/valid submission, implicit Enter submission and reduced motion. One also inspects the accessibility tree and correctly acknowledges the placeholder-derived accessible name. The other four explicitly identify their evidence as source inspection. Runtime evidence from one bundle was not borrowed to justify another.

All 39 unique completed native tool items were reviewed and individually bound. They comprise guidance/product reads, filename listing, hashes, read-only inline Python calculations, and two inspected local browser scripts. No image-generation, publication, package installation, public-root invocation or delegation path appears. The browser scripts use existing dependencies, block nonlocal page requests and close their browsers; this is not an exhaustive host-network audit. Browser profiles are runtime infrastructure rather than authored product changes.

Each review assigns fidelity4 and evidence honesty4. Interaction clarity is3 for the clear source-based audits and4 for the two audits with measured interaction detail. Browser execution was not required to pass the source-based task. Visual design and brand/platform design dimensions are explicitly not applicable because no screen redesign or rendered artifact was requested; audit prose is not used as a substitute for visual-quality evidence. All applicable dimensions meet floor3.

Review records use the requested schema. Every bundle file has a SHA256/byte binding; item hashes use the exact normalized completed item, and bundle-manifest hashes use sorted compact Python JSON with default ASCII escaping. The embedded rubric is separately bound; reconstructed two-space JSON matches the supplied rubric digest without opening variant/source files. `index.json` binds each completed review.

Four passes covered all checks/dimensions, source/runtime accuracy, contradictory interpretations and final evidence/blinding limits. Only opaque reviewer bundles were used. Source instructions, variant mappings and raw trial directories were not opened; visible wording/hashes can still partially reveal identity. The reviewer contributed capture infrastructure but did not author these six model outputs. No model execution, rerender, product edit, historical pooling or adoption approval occurred.
